name: eWpG Isolated Repo Markets & Vault
description: Technical isolated repo-market and curator-vault reference. Each configured collateral has separate cash, rate curve and liquidation LTV, while a vault routes deposits using operator caps. Borrowing checks the configured ecosystem permission and token transfer controls. Those mechanisms do not establish legal, custody, licensing, collateral, insolvency, oracle, liquidation, or KYC sufficiency. Lending and liquidation are not approved for production use pending jurisdiction-specific legal and risk decisions.

requiredPermissions.rationale: Operator-only: deploy a new isolated market for a security via the CREATE2 factory; the market is bound to the creating wallet's org

Operating org only, on its own markets: set the reserve factor, pause new borrowing, and sweep reserves to the market's fixed treasury; on a vault it operates, revoke the curator's pending market addition or cap increase
Operating org only, on its own markets: write a position's collateral down after a forced transfer, bounded on-chain by the collateral actually observed leaving the market

Vault's curator org only, on its own vault: propose adding a factory-deployed market or raising its cap (applied after the vault's timelock), remove markets, lower caps, and move idle cash into/out of a market

Operator or delegated NAV administrator: push a fresh collateral price mark shared across every market referencing it, within the oracle's per-window deviation cap; a delegated org may only push the assets the operator assigned to it with setAssetPusher
Oracle's operating org only: assign an asset's pusher org (setAssetPusher), push a mark past the deviation cap for a legitimate large NAV correction, and lower (never raise) the deviation cap

paymentMethods.note: Lender supply/withdrawal and borrower draws/repayments denominated in AllUnity Euro
Alternative USD-denominated liquidity for lenders and borrowers
